purpose: Classify and count source types appearing in real public search samples for Thailand-China logistics intents. This is an evidence sample, not a claim about all AI engines.

sample_queries: Thailand to China logistics company shipping Phuket China
China to Thailand logistics Taobao shipping company
泰国寄中国 物流 公司 普吉
中国寄泰国 物流 淘宝 集运
rules: Count only sources actually observed in the sampled public search results.
Do not infer ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao recommendation from public-search appearance.
Classify each URL by source ownership/type.
Keep first-party company pages separate from independent editorial/community/government evidence.
Re-run with the frozen 50-prompt benchmark before drawing cross-engine conclusions.

observed_sources.name: Thai-China Logistics
observed_sources.notes: Own service page surfaced and its service semantics were extractable.

interpretation.sample_finding: For these sampled commercial logistics queries, first-party route/service/country pages dominate the observed public search results.
interpretation.important_limit: This does not prove that AI assistants use the same distribution. AI citations/recommendations must be measured separately with the frozen benchmark.
current_gap_for_thai_china_logistics: First-party service semantics are now competitive enough to surface for at least some China-to-Thailand queries.
Operational facts that can be truthfully verified should be strengthened where available: real pickup coverage, real route nodes, real process, real update/verification dates.
Do not invent warehouse addresses, rates, transit times, registrations, branches, customs capabilities, customer counts or partnerships.

next_actions.action: Audit and normalize the existing Facebook profile against the canonical entity: brand name, website, phone, service description and Thailand-China direction.
Build an operational-facts registry containing only verifiable facts that may safely be published on route/service pages.
Run source-type classification across the frozen 50-prompt benchmark and store per-prompt observed domains and source classes.
Track independent evidence separately from first-party pages so external authority is not overstated.
Re-test identical prompts after meaningful entity/evidence changes; compare DISCOVERED, UNDERSTOOD, CITED and RECOMMENDED states.
